_comment: Slug -> Electoral Commission 'RegulatedEntityName' mapping for the Follow the Money section (see docs/follow-the-money-architecture.md). The EC's own registered-party names differ from our policy-side slugs; donations are matched by EXACT RegulatedEntityName (the EC's own field), never fuzzy text search. ec_entity_id is the EC's RegulatedEntityId, kept for reference/cross-check. Scotland-only sister parties (e.g. Scottish Green Party) are SEPARATE EC registrations and deliberately excluded from v1 for cross-party consistency; revisit if/when we add devolved scope.
